Previous imageNext imageSlide 1 of 5, Daily Star back page, Daily Star back pageEnd of image galleryPublished3 hours agoLiverpool leading Chelsea in race for Monaco's Lamine Camara, Barcelona rule out moves for Virgil van Dijk and Bruno Fernandes, and former Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha could rejoin the club.
Liverpool are leading the race for Monaco's Senegal midfielder Lamine Camara, but Chelsea have not ruled out coming back in for the 22-year-old. (Caught Offside), external

Barcelona boss Hansi Flick has dismissed moves for Liverpool's Dutch centre-back Virgil van Dijk, 35, and Manchester United's Portugal midfielder Bruno Fernandes, 32, because of their age. (El Nacional - in Catalan), external
Chelsea target Jules Kounde is increasingly keen to leave Barcelona in January, with the 28-year-old France right-back only starting three La Liga games this season. (Football Insider), external
England midfielder Declan Rice, 27, has verbally agreed terms on a new long-term contract at Arsenal. (Sky Sports), external
Rice will become one of Arsenal's highest earners with a contract that includes a pay rise taking his salary to about £300,000 a week. (Guardian), external
Manchester United and Barcelona are leading the chase to sign Valerenga's highly-rated 15-year-old Norwegian winger Gabriel Rajkovic. (Teamtalk), external

Former Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha, 34, has been training at the club since his contract with Turkish side Galatasaray expired in the summer and the Ivorian could rejoin the Eagles. (Talksport), external
Sunderland are interested in signing former Bournemouth and Newcastle defender Lloyd Kelly, 28, with the Englishman struggling for starts at Juventus. (Chronicle), external

Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni has revealed Lionel Messi could return to the national team as part of his coaching staff, after the 39-year-old Inter Miami forward retired from international football. (TNT Sports), external

England defender Michael Keane's future at Everton is in doubt as the 33-year-old's contract expires in the summer and he has only started one Premier League game this season. (Liverpool Echo), external

Newcastle United and Sunderland will find it difficult to sign Sheffield United's 21-year-old English midfielder Sydie Peck in January as the Blades do not want to sell during the season. (Football Insider), external

Germany manager Jurgen Klopp has revealed he tried to sign national team goalkeeper Marc-Andre ter Stegen, 34, during his time as Liverpool boss, but he chose to remain at Barcelona rather than move to Anfield. (Goal), external
Sunderland want to sign former Cameroon midfielder Franck Zambo Anguissa from Napoli in January - the 31-year-old previously played in the Premier League for Fulham. (Sport Witness), external
QPR's English winger Leon Scarlett, 17, is attracting interest from Eintracht Frankfurt and AC Milan after breaking into the first team this season. (Standard), external
